reena_cs: Drafting a tiny one-pager for "micro-session" customers (lots of short sessions, high churn). Want a paste-ready checklist + tiny snippets.

reena_cs: Topline: 1) server-prefill 2 messages to reduce cold tokens, 2) prefer concat for coherent single replies, small batches (2-3) for parallel tasks, 3) cache prefixes short (20-40s) depending on churn, 4) stream only for active typing UIs, 5) set renewal_watch when token burn spikes.

omar_se: add a simple curl batch snippet + node one-liner for streaming switch.

reena_cs: ```
# batch curl (good for queued micro-sends)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","inputs":["task1","task2"],"max_tokens":90,"stream":false}'

# sdk switch to stream (one-liner)
await client.generate({model:'redwood-mini', input:prompt, stream:true})
```

jin_sre: ops bullets to include: cache_ttl=30s default for micro-sessions; per-tenant concurrency=2; warm-pool: 1 shard for known launch windows; fallback: if p50 latency >350ms for 60s, reduce max_tokens by 25% for mobile.

reena_cs: renewal rule: set "renewal_watch" when 7-day rolling avg tokens >60% of monthly quota OR day-over-day token increase >40% for 3 days. When flagged create CS ticket with last 7d token graph + suggested mitigations.

paul_pm: outreach blurb for CS: "Hi <name> — we noticed short sessions and rising token use. We can help reduce spend with prompt tweaks or enable a short burst while you stabilize. Quick 15-min call?" Keep it friendly.

reena_cs: feedback capture: ping one-question survey 1h after first production session. Example: "How helpful was the last response? (0-10)" -> post to tenant webhook.

cs_bot: Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/micro-session-onboard (access: customer-success, product)

omar_se: tiny UX tip: for streaming on flaky networks, send a short (60-80 char) prefix sync call first, then open stream for remainder to reduce tail latency.

reena_cs: plan: attach this to low-touch kickoff, include as "micro-session runbook" in onboarding email. pls review by EOD or I'll publish. :white_check_mark:
